initialExam.title: Delhi Judicial Services Exam 2026
initialExam.description: Delhi Judicial Services Exam for recruitment of Civil Judges and Magistrates in Delhi courts.
initialExam.eligibility: LLB Degree from recognized university, enrolled as Advocate
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: GK, English, Law. Mains: Civil Law, Criminal Law, Evidence, Constitution, CPC, CrPC.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Preliminary Exam → Mains Exam → Viva Voce → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Civil Judge / Metropolitan Magistrate in Delhi courts
initialExam.careerGrowth: Civil Judge → Additional DJ → District Judge → High Court Judge.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit delhihighcourt.nic.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Government residence, Vehicle, Medical, Pension
